title: PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION and RELATED CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) FINDINGS, and ORDINANCE…
text:
[Council File 26-1414; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION and RELATED CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) FINDINGS, and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to a Zone Change for the properties located at 17317 – 17323 West Ventura Boulevard; (5025 North Louise Avenue).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. DETERMINE, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from CEQA, pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, (Class 1), an exemption from CEQA and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a Categorical Exemption, pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies.
2. ADOPT the FINDINGS of the South Valley Area Planning Commission (SVAPC) as the Findings of Council.
3. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE, dated August 13, 2026, to effectuate a Zone Change from (Q)C4-1VL to (T)C4-1VL; and entails the removal of the (Q) Qualified Classification, which currently applies to a portion of the site situated approximately 170 feet north of the Ventura Boulevard right-of-way and extends to the remainder of the site to allow medical clinic, office or service facility uses, the (Q) Qualified Classification restricts medical clinic, office or service facility uses, the Project proposes a change of use of 11,911 square feet of general office to medical clinic, office or service facility uses; for the property located at 17317 – 17323 West Ventura Boulevard; (5025 North Louise Avenue), subject to Conditions of Approval.
Applicant: 17323 Ventura Prop, LLC
Representative: Kevin Kohan
Case No. APCSV-2025-6834-ZV-SPPC
Environmental No. ENV-2025-6835-CE
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The SVAPC reports that there is no General Fund impact as administrative costs are recovered through fees.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - JANUARY 3, 2027 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 15, 2026
summary: Zone change at 17317-17323 West Ventura Boulevard to lift a restriction on medical clinic and office uses, allowing 11,911 square feet of general office space to convert to medical clinic or office use.
